content.title: CSV exports for accounting must quote every text field per Acme spec ACC-2, not minimal RFC 4180 quoting
content.problem: The sales CSV used minimal RFC 4180 quoting (quote only when a field has comma, quote or newline), so the header row, dates and TOTAL label were unquoted and the accounting interface rejected or failed QA (AC8).
symptoms: header row is not quoted, /api/reports/sales.csv?month=2026-09 line 1: order_number,customer,placed_on,total
CSV for accounting import: text fields not wrapped in double quotes
CSV valid per RFC 4180 but fails organisational format spec

steps: node --test --test-name-pattern=ACC-2 test/csv.test.js (asserts raw text of header and rows)

rootCause.explanation: Implementation assumed RFC 4180 minimal quoting; the organisational rule is stricter. Verbatim, Acme accounting interface spec ACC-2: "CSV files for accounting use CRLF (\r\n) line endings, start with a header row, wrap every text field in double quotes (doubling embedded quotes), and write amounts as plain decimals with two digits." Source: QA feedback, Acme accounting interface spec ACC-2.

failedAttempts.approach: Original design: quote only when needed (RFC 4180) and test via a round-trip parser
failedAttempts.whyFailed: A parser that accepts both quoted and unquoted fields cannot detect missing quotes; tests passed while the spec was violated.

solution.description: Make the field escaper always wrap in double quotes (doubling embedded quotes, after formula neutralisation) and route header names, dates, TOTAL label and empty text fields through it; leave amounts as unquoted two-decimal numbers; keep CRLF. Assert raw output text in tests, not only parsed rows.
solution.tradeoffs: Slightly larger files; only valid for consumers that accept always-quoted CSV (ACC-2 does). Numeric columns must stay unquoted.

sources.title: QA feedback, Acme accounting interface spec ACC-2

appliesWhen: CSV exports for accounting in Acme services
Writing or testing a CSV serializer that must follow an organisational format spec stricter than RFC 4180
notApplicableWhen: Other consumers that have their own CSV spec

reviews.notes: Checked against csv.js and csv.test.js and approved gate phase:rework-1 (npm test ev-muzlhelz-013bbd98 passes). Always-quote fix, unquoted amounts, CRLF and raw-text assertion are all present; the failed-attempt note (round-trip parser cannot detect missing quotes) is accurate. Scope limits are appropriate.
